trace.notes: Normalized https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0010143 to a local PDF. Extracted text shows the paper title 'Thirty-Six Unsolved Problems in Number Theory' and 36 numbered problem blocks spanning pages 7-37.

Collected 36 numbered problem statements. Split mixed-status problems 31 and 33 into separate candidates because each block contains both a solved statement and an open statement. Marked heavily degraded formula-driven items for manual review instead of guessing missing notation.

Rewrote accepted items into standalone questions by expanding shorthand such as 'same question' and by naming the sequences or geometric settings directly when the source text provided enough context.

Kept related but distinct packing questions separate: q_002 is the early general packing/covering question, q_033a is a solved special-case packing problem, and q_033b is the later open generalization. No other near-duplicate clusters were merged.

Accepted items all retain at least one page-numbered source quote. Moved 12 items to needs_review because OCR degradation, ambiguous quantifier notation, or partial solutions made the formulas or exact unresolved scope unreliable for a self-contained rewrite without inventing missing notation.
